sources.note: Town of Moretown (official website), Selectboard minutes: the Selectboard minutes of October 5, 2026 list as members present Tom Martin, Mike Brown, Sam Rosenberg, Callie Streeter, and Don Wexler
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Michael Brown and Thomas Martin among Moretown's selectboard members

Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: the officers table lists the selectboard before the 2026 meeting as Tom Martin, Michael Brown, Robin Campbell, Don Wexler, and Callie Streeter; Campbell's three-year term expired in 2026 and the October 2026 minutes seat Rosenberg in the current five
Town of Moretown (official website), official ballot for the March 3, 2026 town meeting: prints Cherilyn Brown as the candidate for Town Clerk for a three-year term
Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists Cherilyn Brown as Town Clerk

Town of Moretown (official website), official ballot for the March 3, 2026 town meeting: prints Cherilyn Brown as the candidate for Town Treasurer for a three-year term
Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists Cherilyn Brown as Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Cherilyn Brown as Moretown's town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Cherilyn Brown as Moretown's town treasurer
Town of Moretown (official website), official ballot for the March 3, 2026 town meeting: prints Cherilyn Brown as the candidate for Trustee of Public Money for a one-year term
Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists Cherilyn Brown as Trustee of Public Money
Town of Moretown (official website), official ballot for the March 3, 2026 town meeting: prints Craig Eilers as the candidate for Delinquent Tax Collector for a one-year term
Town of Moretown (official website), Tax Collectors page: names Craig Eilers as the Delinquent Tax Collector
Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists Craig Eilers as Delinquent Tax Collector

Town of Moretown (official website), official ballot for the March 3, 2026 town meeting: offers the First Constable two-year seat by write-in only; no outcome is published, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists the outgoing First Constable as Tom Chenette, two-year term expiring 2026; he is not recorded as a current holder
Town of Moretown (official website), official ballot for the March 3, 2026 town meeting: prints Clarence Wood as the candidate for Second Constable
Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists Clarence Wood as Second Constable, one-year term expiring 2026 -- the incumbent standing again in 2026

Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists Steve Magill as Moderator, one-year term expiring 2026; the 2026 floor outcome is not published, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists the three Cemetery Commissioners on staggered three-year terms: Mary Murphy-Blake (expiring 2026), John S. Fulton (2027), and Mark Austin (2028)

Town of Moretown (official website), official ballot for the March 3, 2026 town meeting: offers one Cemetery Commissioner three-year seat, printing Mary Murphy-Blake as the candidate -- the incumbent for the expiring seat

Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists five Library Trustees: Pam Barnes (one-year term expiring 2026, marked appointed), Sybil Schlesinger (one-year, 2026), Dan Zucker (three-year, 2026, marked appointed), Bridget Harty (three-year, 2027), and Erin Hunt (three-year, 2028); the table's note states an appointee must run at the next town meeting for the remaining term

Town of Moretown (official website), official ballot for the March 3, 2026 town meeting: offers a Library Trustee three-year seat printing Sybil Schlesinger, and two one-year seats printing Pam Barnes and April Shaw; Zucker did not stand in 2026 and Shaw, a non-incumbent candidate with no published outcome, is not recorded, so one seat is left unfilled

Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists seven justices of the peace: Steve Magill, Ron Shems, Bridget Harty, Sam Rosenberg, William Nowlan, Sybil Schlesinger, and Kate O'Neill

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the Moretown block lists only four of the seven (Bridget Harty, Stephen Magill, William Nowlan, and Kathryn O'Neill); the town report's superset governs -- see the election note

jp_election.name: Town of Moretown Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the Moretown block lists four justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Bridget Harty, Stephen Magill, William Nowlan, and Kathryn O'Neill. The Town of Moretown's 2025 Town Report officers table lists SEVEN justices of the peace -- the same four plus Ron Shems, Sam Rosenberg, and Sybil Schlesinger -- a superset of the listing, and the table proved seat-accurate for the selectboard, cemetery commission, and library trustees against the town's 2026 ballot. The town report governs and the seven are recorded as the winners. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
Town of Moretown, 2025 Town Report, officers table submitted by the Town Clerk: lists the seven justices of the peace named in the election note
